title: a project whose jitso script is blank gets the plain launcher word in the guard's deny reason
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES L7, defect N-26). The guard and the card share one rule for the jitso script: a blank value is not declared. The reason of a denied worker start names `jitso launch --build <id>`, never `bun run jitso`. The oracle's reason is always `Use: bun run jitso launch --preset <id> ...`, so both reason expectations FAIL on TS.

tool_input.command: orca orchestration worker-start --run r1 --task t1 --terminal term_1
